home.hint: Paste a link anywhere on this page, or drop one here.
home.promise: Saves to the NAS download folder. You can close this page; the download continues on the server.

preview.sizeUnknownHint: The host did not report the file size, which a split download needs.
preview.short: Not enough space: {{size}} short. Free some space, then try again.
preview.duplicateActive: This file is already in the download list.
preview.duplicateFailed: This file failed or was canceled before.

batch.label: Batch of {{count}} links
batch.noneReady: None of these files can be downloaded.
batch.noneSupported: None of these links are from a supported site: {{sites}}.
batch.noRoom_one: Not enough space for this {{count}} file.
batch.noRoom_other: Not enough space for these {{count}} files.
batch.ignored_one: {{count}} other link is not from a supported site and was left out.
batch.ignored_other: {{count}} other links are not from a supported site and were left out.
batch.dropped_one: Up to {{limit}} links at a time; {{count}} more was left out.
batch.dropped_other: Up to {{limit}} links at a time; {{count}} more were left out.
batch.short: Not enough space for all of them: {{size}} short. Free some space, then try again.

tasks.title: Downloads
tasks.emptyLink: Paste a link on the download page
tasks.fileGone: Moved or deleted from the NAS
tasks.videoCorrupt: ffmpeg found problems in this video.

cancel.title: Cancel download
cancel.body: Stop "{{name}}". It stays in the list as canceled, and Retry starts it again from the beginning.

confirmDialog.discards: This discards the {{size}} downloaded so far.
confirmDialog.deleteFile: Also delete the file on the NAS

settings.title: Settings
settings.sharedHint: Saved on the server and shared by everyone.
settings.applyHint: Changes apply to tasks created after you save.
settings.connectionsHint: Links each task downloads over at the same time. More is faster, since each free link is rate limited. 1 to 64.
settings.maxActiveHint: Tasks that download at the same time; the rest wait in the queue. 1 to 10.
settings.splitSizeHint: Files are fetched in parts of this size, and each part resumes on its own. At least 20 MiB.
settings.useProxiesHint: When a free download has to wait, request the download key through public proxies. Your own proxies are always used.
settings.rootHint: Set in the server configuration; it cannot be changed here.
settings.languageHint: Saved in this browser only; other devices keep their own.

toast.started: Download started: {{name}}. You can close this page.
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the path to copy it by hand.
toast.batchStarted_one: Started {{count}} download. You can close this page.
toast.batchStarted_other: Started {{count}} downloads. You can close this page.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check that the service is running, then try again.
errors.unknown: The request could not be completed. Try again.
